purpose: Defines the error handling policy that prevents hiding bugs by forbidding silent fallbacks and allowing only external-cause errors to be caught, for early problem detection and easier debugging.
summary: Overview: prohibit silent fallback and catch only external-cause errors
Scope: all Python scripts and SKILL.md in the project, with background commits
Glossary: external-cause error, internal bug, silent fallback
FR-01 exception catching principle: no broad except, specific types only, propagate bugs
FR-02 allowed catches: file I/O, network, type conversion, HTTP server handlers
FR-03 error reporting: deliver error info to caller in format set by script error output rules
FR-04 pure functions: exceptions are bugs, no rollback, guarantee via tests
Correct and forbidden code patterns with examples
Decision flowchart for handling an exception
Table of applied locations by version
tasks: Reviewing code for silent fallback or broad except
Writing pure functions such as migrations
Fixing bugs hidden by exception handling
